• 40 free spins bonus — wager 25 times the amount of winnings received from the free spins.

• 20 free spins bonus — €400.
• 40 free spins bonus — €750.
Any winnings above the applicable maximum win limit will be forfeited.

If the player's active balance is in another currency, the free spin value, minimum deposit and maximum win limits will be converted into the equivalent amount in the player's active currency.
You can activate your free spins in the Bonus section of your account.
The player can receive a manually credited deposit bonus only if the qualifying deposit amount remains unchanged. In the rare event that the bonus is not granted automatically after a qualifying deposit, please contact Customer Support before placing any bets.
